prose.subject: Payment Required: Oakhurst Catering Report
prose.body: Your report is ready. This HTTP 402 response indicates that payment is required to unlock the full document. The paid report includes the detailed menu breakdown, staffing logistics, and final cost projections for your upcoming event. The total price is 7485.75 USDC. To complete your purchase, please send the exact amount to our designated wallet address: 0xe794eac6d8abdedbcfbd66c16f161bbebe199724. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the link to your report will be regenerated automatically. No other payment methods are accepted for this specific request. Please ensure you use the correct network to avoid delays in processing. If you encounter any issues, our support team can be reached via the contact form on our site. Thank you for choosing Oakhurst Catering for your event needs.
